title: AI Match Symptoms
description: AI-operated semantic matching between classified log entries and documented symptom signatures.
prompt:
You are a specialized diagnostic triage assistant. Analyze the following error log lines and match them semantically against the catalog of documented symptoms. Documented Symptoms:
${symptoms}

Logs to match:
${logs}

Return a JSON list of objects. For each log line that matches a symptom, create an object with fields:
- "id": (integer, log ID)
- "symptom_page": (string, the exact filename of the matched symptom playbook, e.g. "session-failing")
- "confidence": (string, HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW)
- "reason": (string, brief semantic match explanation)

Only return matches with HIGH or MEDIUM confidence. Output the JSON list directly.
